name: cloud-native-serverless-cold-starts
description: Use when the user asks to reduce Lambda cold start latency, Init Duration, provisioned concurrency, SnapStart, GraalVM native Lambdas, Azure Functions or Cloud Run cold starts, or min instances. Produces a measured cold-start diagnosis and fixes for init code, packaging and runtime. Not for Lambda concurrency and event sources (use cloud-native-aws-serverless).
